t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the colours of the gnomes relate to one of each coloured basket. You can figure out through trial and error which correlates to which. One coloured basket for a period will produce more mushrooms overall than the other, but this will keep switching over periods of time.

vb_textbox.text: There are different coloured gnomes that correlate to either a red or yellow basket. For some periods of time, the red basket will provide better results and this may switch to the yellow basket and back and forth. There were also periods where neither provided good results, so this theory might not be right. There are other variables like the multiplier and the type of gnome (short mushroom or long mushroom) that might affect this.
